notes.title: V1.10 update instructions
notes.content:
1. New gameplay: the heroic difficulty is added to the story dungeon. Each fight can be played once in each turn.Once you hit a hero, you get a diamond.It can be exchanged for higher powers and carjans.
2, New skills: plan to add 2 new spells and 2 new martial arts, all of which are advanced skills.You need to exchange them with a power drill.
3. Strengthen the AI of TANK and healing profession in combat.
TANK attracts hate, healing takes priority to recover TANK.
4. Small functions: ask for reminder from Party salary
5. Reduce the probability of the successful refining of the Dan.(to encourage the diamond to buy the Dan)
6. Fix some functional bugs

	B. When inviting players to ban the land, adjust the difficulty appropriately.
	C, some adjustments in the fight.
3. The "main acquisition" is marked on the task interface.
4, adjust "" hundred fairies" "and" "keep city mission" "gains
	Chance to get premium herbal and Dan medicine.
5. Equipment, Dan drugstore plus suspension title.
6. Other bugs have been found.

notes.title: V1.06(08.14) version update with "R shortcut " feature
notes.content:
1.Add the "quick release skill" function, and the shortcut key is R.
After using skill to attack the enemy in combat, use R again later.
Tip in the upper left corner of the battle.
2.Fixed Dan medicine deduction BUG.
3.Reduces the Mana Up BUFF to 60 points.
4.Reduced the effect of the drugs, zhenyuan Dan 8% of blood volume, 15% of the blood volume.
It also increases the role of your abilities in the Dujie (talent points, spells, equipment, etc.)
5.Once again reduce the kill Qi and Lian zhan values.

notes.title: V1.04 update instructions
notes.content:
1. Add the function of adjusting combat speed
    In the Settings panel, check "fight fast"
    To cancel fast combat, remove the tick
    Tip: you can also open the Settings panel by clicking "ESC" in the game

2. Fixed the BUG of refining the equipment while refining the equipment
    Stabilizing refining equipment
